in_marathi.name: Drishti
in_marathi.long_meaning: Drishti हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Drishti refers to the ability to see or perceive. It is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘drsh’, which means ‘to see’. In Hindu mythology, Drishti is associated with the goddess Saraswati, the deity of knowledge and wisdom.

vedic_reference.note: Drishti is a name of the goddess Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge and learning. She is also known as 'Vidya Drishti' or 'the one who gives the vision of knowledge'. Drishti is also the name of the deity associated with the third eye or the inner vision.
